analysis.rationale: Revenue and profit growth are strong, with record highs and a 42.75% EBITDA increase. Capacity expansions and robust order book support sustained growth.
analysis.summary: Universal Cables reported highest-ever revenue of ₹3,022.67 crore, up 25.5% YoY, with net profit rising 68.5% to ₹96.53 crore, and recommended a dividend of ₹4.50 per share.
